training.serialization_normalization: Unicode NFC plus collapsing and trimming whitespace
training.eos_loss_weight: run-specific; read from run_manifest.json, not from this policy

evaluation.exact_match: same NFC/whitespace-normalized string; reported separately from semantic verifier
evaluation.generation_termination: EOS termination and max-length failure are reported separately; missing EOS is not correctness

supported_rules.integer: strict signed decimal integer; no trailing text
supported_rules.boolean: explicit spelling table only: true, false, yes, no
supported_rules.fraction: exact rational arithmetic; reduced and unreduced forms equivalent; denominator nonzero
supported_rules.decimal: exact Decimal arithmetic; finite values and strict full-string syntax only

evaluation.unsupported_reason: No approved safe, type-specific semantic parser yet

fraction_policy: reduced and unreduced equivalent via exact rational arithmetic
normalization_does_not_perform: radix conversion without explicit source metadata
historical_compatibility: Runs labeled provisional-v1-whitespace-nfc-exact remain historical artifacts; re-evaluate into new files before comparing semantic metrics.
warning: This is provisional and must not be reported as final semantic accuracy.
